mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_message (session_id, `role`, content, image_url, reasoning_content, reasoning_ms, model, fallback, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{reasoningContent}, #{reasoningMs}, #{model}, #{fallback}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO t_ai_message_image (message_id, sort_no, image_url, created_at) VALUES
(#{messageId}, #{i}, #{url}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, sort_no, image_url, created_at FROM t_ai_message_image WHERE message_id IN #{id} ORDER BY message_id ASC, sort_no ASC
SELECT id, session_id, `role`, content, image_url, reasoning_content, reasoning_ms, model, fallback, created_at FROM t_ai_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT i.image_url FROM t_ai_message_image i JOIN t_ai_message m ON i.message_id = m.id WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} UNION SELECT image_url FROM t_ai_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND image_url IS NOT NULL AND image_url <> ''
mapper.delete: DELETE i FROM t_ai_message_image i JOIN t_ai_message m ON i.message_id = m.id WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT image_url FROM t_ai_message_image WHERE image_url IN #{url} UNION SELECT image_url FROM t_ai_message WHERE image_url IN #{url}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ai_message m JOIN t_ai_session s ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND m.`role` = 'user'

SELECT i.image_url FROM t_ai_message_image i JOIN t_ai_message m ON i.message_id = m.id JOIN t_ai_session s ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT m.image_url FROM t_ai_message m JOIN t_ai_session s ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND m.image_url IS NOT NULL AND m.image_url <> ''
